thread:
mike_support: Customer on prod is failing when calling create_order in JSON mode — runtime returns 422 / Invalid function args: missing required key 'order_id'. Happening intermittently across ~10% of requests. Shared a sample request and the runtime response below.

mike_support: Request (snippet):
```json
{
  "action": "create_order",
  "args": {
    "order-id": "ORD-12345",
    "items": [{"sku": "X1", "qty": 2}],
    "meta": "{\"customer\":\"ACME\"}"
  }
}
```

mike_support: Runtime response: 422 SchemaMismatch: required key "order_id" missing at path $.args. Also logs show: "TypeError: expected object for $.args.meta but got string"

julia_eng: Thanks — can you paste the full runtime log lines (with request id) and the LLM model + runtime version? Also which SDK/version customer used.

mike_support: Logs (redacted):
```
2024-06-18T14:12:05Z [req=rt-0a1b2c] handler=fncall runtime=redwood-runtime v2.4.1 model=gpt-open-7b
2024-06-18T14:12:06Z [req=rt-0a1b2c] ERROR SchemaMismatch: missing required key 'order_id' at args
2024-06-18T14:12:06Z [req=rt-0a1b2c] ERROR TypeMismatch: expected object at args.meta, got string
2024-06-18T14:12:06Z [req=rt-0a1b2c] response=422 duration_ms=1320
```

mike_support: Customer says their client lib is a third-party integration (vendor X) that minifies keys and replaces underscores with hyphens. They also serialize metadata into a string earlier in their stack.

raj_sre: Hmm, two separate issues: 1) dashed keys vs snake_case -> validation fails because schema declares order_id required. 2) meta typed as object in function schema but client sends stringified JSON. Both will cause fncall rejection. Is vendor X doing any Content-Type changes or double-encoding?

mike_support: Confirmed vendor X sends Content-Type: application/json and the body is JSON, but their library changes keys before sending. Example: they map order_id -> order-id.

julia_eng: Repro steps request: can you get a curl capture from the customer (raw bytes)? If we can repro locally we can decide whether to accept dashed keys as alias or update docs/SDK to normalize. Short-term workaround: add a server-side tolerant patch that will coerce hyphenated keys to snake_case and attempt to parse stringified meta as JSON if schema expects object. We'll need a rollout plan because that changes validation behavior and could mask bugs.

lina_pm: +1 on needing a careful rollout. Also this has billing/latency implications — their clients retried on 5xx previously and we saw elevated token counts. What's the customer impact?

mike_support: Customer reports ~5% order creation failure rate, increased retries causing ~30% more tokens billed in that window. They want a fix or clear guidance for vendor X ASAP.

julia_eng: Plan: 1) get raw curl and sample failing payloads (mike to request), 2) create a small adapter in ingester to normalize hyphenated keys and try safe parse of meta string -> object (feature flag rollout behind canary), 3) add telemetry to track how many requests are auto-normalized, 4) update docs + SDK guidance and open a compatibility ticket with vendor X.

raj_sre: Also add a 1% traffic canary in eu-west-1 to watch for any regressions (latency or error changes). Keep default off for enterprise customers unless they opt-in.

mike_support: Created ticket REDWOOD-3421 for the adapter + canary. Reached out to customer for curl/raw body. Will update here when we have the artifact. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Incident ticket created: #REDWOOD-3421 (adapter for hyphenated keys + meta coercion) assigned to julia_eng, priority P2.

mike_support: FYI — customer provided raw payload shortly after: confirmed hyphenated keys and meta string. Pasting obfuscated raw body in case helpful: `{"action":"create_order","args":{"order-id":"ORD-12345","items":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}],"meta":"{\"customer\":\"ACME\"}"}}`.

julia_eng: Great, I'll start a local repro and prototype the adapter. If anyone sees other customers hit this pattern, paste them here so we can assess scope.

mike_support: Will do. Thanks team.
